lineage.description: The aridity index (AI) was calculated from long-term climate data to create a spatiotemporally continuous drought hazard dataset at 0.05° resolution. The dataset provides empirical estimates of aridity conditions across Ethiopia for drought assessment, dryland ecosystem research, and climate change applications.
